name: Jungle Zoo Ocean Passthrough Handtracking Demo
summary:
Create a Jungle, Zoo, and Ocean in your home with Passthrough mixed reality and optional hand tracking.

This is a demo of "Jungle Zoo Ocean Passthrough Handtracking"
- in this demo there are 45 second round limits, there is no timer in the full version (search the store for the exact full name to find it)
- Featuring the best of “Jungle Passthrough”, “Ocean Passthrough”, “ZOSU Zoo Home Passthrough” with improvements.

There are over 60 animals, 100 sea creatures, and 70 plants to move, spawn, and delete.
